current_evidence: The council's 'Planning validation document' page describes this as the latest version 'published in June 2025' and links it with Checklists 1-10 and Appendices 1-4. The PDF cover reads 'Planning Validation Document, Update June 2025'.

issues.detail: Several county-specific local requirements (mostly minerals/waste) are not captured as requirements. Bio-Aerosol Assessment: composting or shredding organic matter within 250m of sensitive receptors. Control of Litter, Vermin and Birds: processes that could attract vermin/birds or generate litter. Geodiversity Assessment: all mineral developments and risks to geodiversity sites; Appendix 2 was also not read. Green Belt Statement: all development within or partly within the Green Belt, including grey belt. Restoration and Aftercare Scheme (mineral working/landfill). Soil Handling Strategy. Public Rights of Way Assessment. Safeguarding Mineral Sites and Supporting Infrastructure Assessment. Land Stability Assessment: development on or adjoining land known or suspected to be unstable; folded into the coal-mining row without its own trigger.
issues.evidence: Validation Document June 2025 contents: 'Bio-Aerosol Assessment', 'Control of Litter, Vermin and Birds', 'Geodiversity Assessment', 'Green Belt Statement', 'Public Rights of Way Assessment', 'Restoration and Aftercare Scheme', 'Safeguarding Mineral Sites and Supporting Infrastructure Assessment', 'Soil Handling Strategy'

issues.detail: The Surface Water Drainage Strategy (backed by Appendix 3, the LLFA Surface Water Checklist) is effectively missing. Grokbot's 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' row contains the Foul Sewage Drainage Strategy / Utilities Assessment text, so it duplicates the Foul Sewage row and states no surface water trigger.
issues.evidence: Grokbot 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' trigger: 'FOUL SEWAGE DRAINAGE STRATEGY / UTILITIES ASSESSMENT When might it be required? A Foul Sewage Assessment is required where...'; source has a separate 'Surface Water Drainage Strategy' heading

issues.detail: The only Householder row is the Coal Mining Risk Assessment, whose own trigger text excludes householder applications. A county planning authority does not determine householder applications in any case.
issues.evidence: 'COAL MINING RISK ASSESSMENT When might it be required? For all non-householder applications which fall within the Coal Mining Development High Risk Areas'

issues.detail: All 35 'County own devt (Reg 3)' rows are sourced from Checklist 2 (Outline planning applications), not Checklist 1 (County Council's own developments), although Checklist 1 is in docs_read. All 'Minerals & waste (county)' rows except one come from Checklist 4 (waste management facilities except landfill). Checklist 3 (Mineral working) and Checklist 5 (Landfill) were read but not used, so minerals- and landfill-specific items are absent.
issues.evidence: Validation page links: 'Checklist 1 - County Council's own developments', 'Checklist 3 - Mineral working', 'Checklist 5 - Landfill'; Grokbot sources: checklist_2_-_outline_planning_applications.pdf for Reg 3 rows

issues.detail: Lawful development cert is marked '(none)', but the council publishes Checklist 6 (LDC existing use) and Checklist 7 (LDC proposed use). Neither was read. The Photographs heading also says some LDC applications need photographs.

Checklist 9 (Demolition) requirements are filed under 'Change of use - prior approval': tree survey, ecology, photographs, planning statement, structural survey and emissions. Meanwhile 'Demolition in cons area' is marked '(none)'. A 'Lighting Assessment' from Checklist 1 is filed under Listed building consent.
issues.evidence: Grokbot rows for 'Change of use - prior approval' all have source checklist_9_-_demolition.pdf

issues.detail: Several rows are mislabelled: the requirement name does not match the source text attached. 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical / Basement' is the Water Environment Hydrology/Hydrogeology Assessment. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is the Safeguarding Waste Management Facilities Assessment (non-waste development on, adjacent to or within 250m of a waste site). 'Ventilation / Extraction details (odour)' is the Emissions Assessment (dust, noise, odours, vibration). 'Minerals / Waste specific statements' is the Mineral Resource Assessment (non-exempt development in Mineral Consultation Areas). 'Open space / play space' is the Playing Pitch Assessment, but its trigger is a list of Sport England guidance titles.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger for 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details': '80 SAFEGUARDING WASTE MANAGEMENT FACILITIES ASSESSMENT When might it be required? For all non-waste related development on or adjacent to a site with...'

issues.detail: Many triggers are fragments or lack the actual trigger. 'Sunlight to gardens/amenity space' is just 'gardens or amenity space.'. 'Archaeological Assessment' is 'submit an Archaeological Assessment.' (archaeology sits within the Heritage Statement heading). 'Environmental Statement' carries the coal-mining sentence about including the CMRA in an ES. 'Photographs' under Full planning carries BNG small-sites metric text. 'Sequential / Exception Test (flood)' is a single sentence. 'Health Impact Assessment' gives a definition instead of the trigger: mineral working in all areas; in South Worcestershire and Wyre Forest also waste development, buildings of 1,000sqm+ or sites of 1ha+. 'Design and Access Statement' says only 'not required for all developments' and omits major development, 100sqm+ in designated areas, and LBC.
issues.evidence: Source HIA Screening: 'Mineral working in all areas. In South Worcestershire and Wyre Forest, also waste development, buildings of 1,000 sq m or more, or sites of 1 hectare or more'

issues.detail: 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' is not a county requirement. Every instance (Full, Outline, Reg 3, s73, Minerals & waste) carries the Agricultural Land Classification Statement text, duplicating the 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' row. The Travel Plan and Transport rows, and the 'Statement of Community Involvement' and 'Pre-application advice' rows, also repeat the same Consultation Statement text.
issues.evidence: Grokbot trigger: '7 AGRICULTURAL LAND CLASSIFICATION STATEMENT When might it be required? For all applications that could affect best and most versatile agricultural land (Grades 1, 2 or 3a)'

issues.detail: 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' rows under Advertisement consent, Demolition and the checklist-based types are advice ('It is strongly advised that you have a pre-application discussion...'), not validation requirements. Several tab_items are background or guidance prose rather than requirements. Examples: HRA background on SPA bird species ('The floodplain of the Vale is a critical habitat ... curlew, redshank, wigeon...'), 'The report notes that many species ... rely on the wider Severn & Avon landscape', and an Air Quality technical-guidance description filed as a 'Submission rule'.
issues.evidence: Checklist 8/9: 'It is strongly advised that you have a pre-application discussion with a member of the Development Management Team'

issues.detail: The 36 Full planning rows are all flagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning'. For a county planning authority the relevant categories are minerals, waste and the County Council's own (Reg 3) development, which have their own checklists. The 'Full planning' column therefore duplicates the main document rather than reflecting how the source assigns requirements.
issues.evidence: Validation page lists checklists by type: own developments, outline, mineral working, waste, landfill, LDC, advertisements, demolition, s73

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Worcestershire County Validation Document (June 2025), but the extraction is unreliable. About nine county-specific requirements are missing (Bio-Aerosol, Litter/Vermin/Birds, Geodiversity, Green Belt Statement, Restoration and Aftercare, Soil Handling, PRoW, Safeguarding Minerals, Surface Water). Many rows carry another requirement's text, Reg 3 rows come from the Outline checklist, and the Minerals/Landfill and LDC checklists are ignored.
